source_request: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: 장난스러운 플러팅 상호작용: 두 성인의 미완 접근-후퇴 물건 교환, 깨어 있는 대상 시선, 절제된 비대칭 미소, 동일 수신자의 반응을 한 프레임에 시각화한다.
subject: Two unmistakably adult fragrance archivists, ages 29 and 34; the initiator uses an adult facial-appearance reference only for facial features.
setting: A closed rooftop winter garden with rain-beaded glass, potted citrus, and a velvet-lined tray of restored 1930s atomizers at pre-dawn after summer rain.
event: The initiator begins to withdraw a brass catalog key immediately after half-offering it to the same adult recipient, whose stopped reach visibly answers the unfinished action.
visual_priorities: Keep the same adult recipient, the offered-and-withdrawn key, and both hands legible in one frame.
Show awake target-directed eyes and a small asymmetric closed-lip smile on the initiator.
Show the recipient's stopped step, fixed gaze, and open reaching hand as a visible response to the same key.
Preserve tactile hammered satin, brushed mohair, brass, silk, and rain-beaded glass.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a non-explicit fashion-editorial photograph inside a closed rooftop winter garden at pre-dawn after summer rain. Two unmistakably adult fragrance archivists, ages 29 and 34, pause beside a velvet-lined tray of restored 1930s atomizers. The 29-year-old initiator uses the adult facial-appearance reference only for facial features, wearing an ink-black hammered-satin column dress; the 34-year-old recipient wears a pearl-gray brushed-mohair dinner jacket. The initiator half-offers a small brass catalog key on a burnt-orange silk ribbon toward that same recipient, then draws it back one inch while the key remains visibly suspended between them. Her awake eyes stay fixed on the recipient and a small asymmetric closed-lip smile is clearly visible. The same recipient has stopped mid-step, keeps their eyes on the key, and reaches one open hand toward it with restrained surprise. Frame both adults and both hands in an eye-level three-quarter two-shot, 50 mm perspective. Mix cool cyan storm light through rain-beaded glass with one warm tungsten table lamp, preserving natural skin texture, crisp hand geometry, tactile satin, mohair, brass, and silk.
